scope: Prospective paired engine comparison on GH200: five previously unused seeds, each run once with the analytic engine and once with the parameter-AD engine, sequentially on one GPU in one job. Primary measurement: active training seconds to a registered loss threshold; the threshold checkpoint of each arm is then verified physically. The instance, data, FP64 network, Adam4000 and dense SSBroyden, numerical tolerances, physical gates, observer and auditor (revision 2) are those of the second TTA cohort. No pooling with earlier cohorts.

instance.note: the original instance of v1-v5; inputs are data/ unchanged

arms.fresh: Fresh deterministic initialization, original Adam4000 then SSBroyden; same optimizer state retained across physical inspections.

training.engine: both engines, one arm each; see pair

optimizer.method: self-scaled Broyden (SSBroyden), dense inverse Hessian in FP64 on the GPU
optimizer.update: Urban, Stefanou and Pons, J. Comput. Phys. 523 (2025) 113656, Eqs. (10), (13)-(23); identical to Kiyani et al., arXiv:2501.16371, Eq. (15) and its definitions; box376.ssbroyden
optimizer.H0: identity (as Kiyani et al.; the update scaling tau adapts it)
optimizer.safeguards: update skipped when y.s <= 1e-12 |y||s|; H reset to I when a direction is not a descent direction or the line search gives no decrease; two consecutive resets end the optimizer phase
optimizer.one_matvec_per_iteration: H y = H g_{k+1} + d_k; H_{k+1} g_{k+1} carried in O(n) and checked against an explicit product at every complete-gradient check

training.maximum_training_seconds_reason: 4000 active training seconds at optimizer boundaries, including training checks/checkpoint IO; synchronous physical observation pauses this clock. No restart or extension.
training.trainer: box376.potential_train_tta; same Adam and SSBroyden mathematics, new-seed qualification and synchronous physical inspections
training.gradient_reference: Fresh full dense parameter AD at initialization and all original periodic checks; separate fixed 131-point native coordinate AD subset with complete parameter gradient per seed

physical.state_observer: native coordinate AD of the trained curl-potential network

physical_observation.note: One synchronous full observation of each arm's threshold checkpoint; none for an arm that misses the threshold.

decision_rule.primary_ratio: parameter-AD active training seconds to the threshold / analytic active training seconds to the threshold, per seed
decision_rule.jointly_accepted: both arms reach the threshold within the guard, both threshold checkpoints pass physical acceptance, both independent audits pass

outcomes.ANALYTIC_FASTER: at least 4 jointly accepted pairs, geometric mean ratio > 1.03 and at least 4 pairs with ratio > 1
outcomes.PARAMETER_AD_FASTER: at least 4 jointly accepted pairs, geometric mean ratio < 1/1.03 and at least 4 pairs with ratio < 1
outcomes.NO_DECIDED_DIFFERENCE: at least 4 jointly accepted pairs and neither of the above

decision_rule.formal_scope: solve-level time to a fixed training loss with physical verification, analytic vs parameter-AD engine, this instance, one GH200; not a broad Navier-Stokes claim

execution.allocation: one independent job per seed, one GH200, 16 CPUs, 128 GiB host memory, 5 hours maximum; both arms run sequentially on the same GPU
execution.node_count_reason: Each seed is a separately released one-GPU job; running both arms on the same GPU removes between-node variation from the paired ratio and leaves no card idle.
execution.start_command: Each batch embeds box376.run_c36_pair --packet FROZEN_PACKET --root SEED_ROOT --seed REGISTERED_SEED --deadline-unix SLURM_END_MINUS_900; both arms, synchronous observers, checked full raw archive and immediate batch exit. Independent CPU readback follows release.
execution.failure_archive: outer finite process-group timeout and finalizer preserve negative and partial outputs even if the inner driver fails
execution.protocol_changes: paired engines, loss-threshold stopping and one observation per arm; the instance, solver mathematics, numerical and physical gates and auditor are those of the second TTA cohort
execution.worst_case_seconds: analytic arm 1,300 setup + 2,500 training + 4,200 observation; parameter-AD arm 400 + 2,500 + 4,200; total 15,100 < 18,000 - 900

amendments.change: allocation 3 h -> 2 h on QoS an interactive QoS; maximum_training_seconds 6,600 -> 4,000; deadline reserve 900 -> 400 s
amendments.reason: the regular QoS is unavailable (allocation exhausted); user instruction to use an interactive QoS, whose maximum wall time is 2 h

amendments.change: independent two-seed fresh-arm GH200 batch; retain the 4,000 s training cap and all mathematical gates
amendments.reason: the earlier cluster route was retired at the user's request; exact v5 continuation checkpoints unavailable; GH200 full-gradient compatibility qualified

amendments.change: Prospective five-seed formal TTA protocol with independent single-card jobs, synchronous 1000/4000-second inspections and 4-hour allocation ceiling; stop upon confirmed physical acceptance
amendments.reason: User requested new-seed formal time-to-accuracy validation, protocol frozen first and per-seed immediate release.

amendments.change: second prospective cohort: new seeds and holdout, revision 2 of the independent auditor; nothing else changes
amendments.reason: the v1 cohort is not qualified because its frozen auditor tolerance rejects cross-architecture rounding of cancelled sums; the user asked for compute on demand to continue

amendments.change: paired analytic vs parameter-AD engine cohort with loss-threshold stopping
amendments.reason: the second TTA cohort gives an absolute time but no baseline; the user approved a paired engine cohort

qualification.native_subset_scope: 131 fixed interior points plus all value families, complete 50692 parameter gradient; not a new full-coordinate-AD objective proof

time_to_accuracy.note: only the observer settings apply to the paired cohort

engine_descriptions.analytic: compiled packed activation with analytic transpose, CUDA Graph replay (as v2, v5 and the TTA cohorts)
engine_descriptions.parameter_ad: compiled packed-forward activation with PyTorch autograd parameter gradient, CUDA Graph replay (the internal control of v2, v5 and v6)

pair.threshold_basis: informed by development data: all nine audited passing first inspections of the TTA cohorts lie at losses 6.7e-9 to 1.7e-8; the threshold is evaluated at accepted SSBroyden iterates
pair.native_subset_note: the fixed native coordinate-AD subset checks the analytic eager path, which does not depend on the training engine; it runs once per seed, in the analytic arm. Both arms run their own eager, compiled and graph checks against dense parameter AD.
pair.arm_order_rule: alternating across seeds in registered seed order (analytic first for seeds 1, 3, 5)
pair.primary_measurement: active training seconds (Adam and SSBroyden, including the periodic checks and checkpoints that both arms share) at the first accepted SSBroyden iterate with loss <= threshold, recorded before any check of that iterate
secondary_measurements: setup seconds excluding the native subset
pair.not_reached: an arm that misses the threshold within the guard is recorded as NOT_REACHED and its pair is not jointly accepted; it is not observed

independent_audit.basis: box376.audit_c36_tta_v2 per arm (rounding-bounded raw arrays and metrics), plus the threshold consistency checks
